audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart said 'Skill' for rows 0-5 while the content layer and the packet levelChart say Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Orianna. The page renders two different answers for the same rows.
audit.why: Ahri has no Charm at level 1 and Orianna's passive-stacked autos plus 815-range Command: Attack win the opening levels; from 4-5 Charm's flat 12s cooldown and Fox-Fire chip win extended trades, and Spirit Rush at 6 (three dashes, 140s at rank 1) lets her dodge a telegraphed Shockwave. Two items later Shockwave's multi-catch outvalues her single-target burst.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides aligned to the content layer and packet: Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Ahri, Ahri, Ahri, Orianna, with each why rewritten to match its new verdict.

audit.why: Spikes read correctly: Lost Chapter at 4-5, Ahri's level 6 Spirit Rush, first-item tempo hers, two items flipping to Orianna's Shockwave. Cooldown numbers added where the prose was vague.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the 140s rank-1 Spirit Rush and the three dashes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two kit interactions were absent: Orb of Deception's return deals true damage (MR does not help), and Essence Theft heals Ahri after 9 minions. breakdown.cooldowns also contained no number at all.
audit.why: Both are decisive here — Orianna players buy MR to fight a mage, and the lane is decided in extended trades where Ahri's sustain resets the chip war. Charm's cooldown is flat 12s at every rank and 975 range, which is the single number that governs when Orianna may step up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early names the true-damage return; 'ahead' names Essence Theft's 9-minion heal; breakdown.cooldowns now carries Charm's 12s / 975 range and Fox-Fire's 9/8/7/6/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: 28 lint findings: 25 misgender entries calling Ahri 'he/his', 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 unsupported magnitude, 1 cooldowns field with no digit.

notes: Chart: the full layer read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Orianna while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Orianna. I moved the FULL sides onto the content values, so no paired win[N] edit was possible — win[N] already holds the target string and a before==after edit would be rejected. After this proposal the two layers agree on all seven rows. phases[N].why rewritten in the same proposal for every side that moved. Orianna R cooldown is 110/95/80 per the kit; the old don'ts bullet implied otherwise, so I used 110. Anti-heal note: Essence Theft heals after 9 minions/monsters and more on a takedown — folded into 'ahead' rather than inventing a Grievous Wounds item timing the kit does not give. Rating edits withdrawn: the existing phases[N].rating values track difficulty-for-Orianna (higher = harder), so renumbering them by who-wins-the-row would have inverted the signal. Sides and whys were moved; ratings left as found.
